Settle order ORD-22F56455A324. First look up its quantity and unit price. After receiving that result, use the multiplication tool to compute the total in integer minor units. After receiving the product, save it as the order total. Validate the saved order. After receiving successful validation, return only JSON with order_id, total_minor, and validated. Do not change any other order.
